earnings.title: DIAMONDBACK ENERGY, INC. ANNOUNCES THIRD QUARTER 2026 FINANCIAL AND OPERATING RESULTS; INCREASES BASE DIVIDEND
highlights: Net cash provided by operating activities of $2.6 billion; Operating Cash Flow Before Working Capital Changes 1 of $3.2 billion
Free Cash Flow 1 and Adjusted Free Cash Flow 1 of $2.1 billion and $2.2 billion, respectively
Increased annual base dividend by 7.3% to $4.72 per share; marks an 18% year over year increase and a ~2.2% annualized yield
Repurchased 1.3 million shares of common stock for approximately $251 million
Repurchased $106 million in aggregate principal amount of 2054 and 2064 Senior Notes at a weighted average price of 94.9% of par ($103 million, including accrued interest)
outlook: Increasing annual oil production guidance to ~524 (from 522+) MBO/d with total BOE production of ~1,015 (from 1,000+) MBOE/d and full year cash capital expenditures to $3.95 - $4.00 billion (from ~$3.9 billion)
Q4 2026 cash capital expenditures guidance of $1,000 - $1,050 million

items.heading: Geopolitics and market conditions for oil and natural gas, and particularly volatility in prices for oil and natural gas, have in the past adversely affected, and may in the future adversely affect, our revenue, cash flows, profitability, growth, production and the present value of our estimated reserves.
